title: Elf Bar 600 P&B Cloud Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Elf Bar 600 P&B Cloudd Prefilled Pods offer a playful, sweet vape for the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit. Each pod is filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, providing a smooth MTL draw and up to 600 puffs. This flavour recreates the nostalgic taste of fairground-style candyfloss, delivering a sugary inhale balanced by a cooling icy exhale. Pods are quick to replace—just pop in a new one when finished for a seamless, mess-free vape.
